$comment: Agency 2026 interface sound palette for showcase films. Generated with ElevenLabs sound generation through Ent Tools by showcase/kit/tools/sfx.mjs. Files: <id>.wav (48 kHz, peak -3 dBFS) and <id>.m4a. gain_db is the default level of an event before the film's sfxGain. Rules of use: guides/SOUND.md, Sound effects.
style: Soft, modern, tactile interface sounds. Dry and close, no reverb tail, no music, no voice, no background noise.

sounds.use: one key press while text types
sounds.prompt: One single soft laptop keyboard key press, quiet low-profile key, dry and close, no reverb, no background noise, isolated
One single soft keyboard key tap, slightly lower pitch, quiet low-profile key, dry and close, no reverb, isolated
One single gentle keyboard key click, slightly higher and lighter, quiet low-profile key, dry and close, no reverb, isolated

sounds.use: light typing under a field that fills
sounds.prompt: Light fast typing on a quiet low-profile laptop keyboard, steady even rhythm, soft key taps only, dry and close, no reverb, no background noise
One soft modern user interface button press, short muted tactile click, premium app sound, dry, no reverb, isolated
One soft user interface toggle switch turning on, two tiny muted ticks rising in pitch, premium app sound, dry, no reverb, isolated
Very soft short airy whoosh rising, a light panel gliding in, subtle and smooth, no impact, dry, no reverb, isolated
Very soft short airy whoosh falling away, a light panel gliding out, subtle and smooth, no impact, dry, no reverb, isolated
One soft round message pop, gentle bubble notification of a chat message arriving, short, warm, dry, no reverb, isolated
One soft message sent sound, short gentle upward swish with a light pluck, premium messaging app, dry, no reverb, isolated

sounds.use: a list row or record entry appears
sounds.prompt: One single tiny dry tick, like one tick of a small clock or a pen tap on a desk, extremely short, one transient only, no tone, no ringing, isolated
One soft low muted thud, a padded block settling into place, short, round, gentle, dry, no reverb, isolated
Fast even soft ticking of a mechanical number counter rolling, light delicate ticks, steady rhythm, dry, no reverb, no background noise
sounds.take: 1 of 3; 45 ms cut from the start by hand so the first tick is on the event time

sounds.prompt: Soft success chime, two gentle marimba-like notes rising, D then F sharp, D major, short, warm, clean, minimal reverb, isolated
Short soft rising tone that ends with a light bright ping, a circular progress ring completing, clean, dry, no reverb, isolated
Very subtle short soft low swell, a gentle breath of air, barely audible lens focus shift, smooth, dry, no reverb, isolated
Soft modern phone call connecting tone, two gentle short beeps rising, clean sine tones, dry, no reverb, isolated

sounds.use: the AI agent starts to speak
sounds.prompt: One tiny soft round blip, a voice assistant starting to speak, short gentle sine tone, dry, no reverb, isolated
